title: By nine months, most babies smile or laugh at peekaboo
summary: The CDC says that by nine months, most babies smile or laugh when you play peekaboo.
body: Under social and emotional milestones at nine months, the CDC lists a smile or a laugh when you play peekaboo. The page spells the game peek-a-boo. The line is one item for most babies by that age on the US list. It does not say the game is a lesson with a passing score.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the social item 'Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo.'
